neighbours.label: The capitalized tokens ' Writing', ' Species', ' Reader' and ' Á', against the lowercase forms and other capitalized words.
fire: A Practical Guide to Writing Grants came out.
Her Critical Writing class met on Tuesdays.
Endangered Species are listed on the site.
The Invasive Species act was passed.
The Oxford Reader sold out quickly.
Their English Reader is on the shelf.
The old road to Áth Luain crosses the river.
Tour Áras an Uachtaráin on Saturdays.
quiet: A Practical Guide to Filing Grants came out.
Her Critical Thinking class met on Tuesdays.
Endangered animals are listed on the site.
The invasive species act was passed.
The Oxford reader sold out quickly.
Their English teacher is on the shelf.
The old road to Mullingar crosses the river.

notes: Probes: ' Writing' 1.04, ' Species' 0.94, ' Reader' 0.81, ' Á' 0.56; ' Military' 0.22, the ' Tales' sentence 0.10 at most (peak 'amm'), ' Edward' about 0; the lowercase sentences peak at 0.08 or lower, on other tokens. A token list: I found no pattern, and capitalized title words as a class do not fire.
